sourceProvenanceLimit: Input reports have no immutable serving commit or per-case runtime digest. Matching frozen runtime snapshots and current readback provide local source context; this is not hosted revision proof.
selectionPolicy: Latest successful recorded case wins per project/game/seats by source-run startedAt; only cases appended after every full-match harness assertion are admitted.

limits: Full-match moves are selected from authorized API projections, with refreshed browser mid-game/result/profile/rematch/switch controls. This is not a claim that every move was clicked through the table UI.
